Container.Name: Net-Portfolios
Container.Overview: Dark, glassmorphism photography portfolio with six gallery layouts, an About panel and a contact form that emails you through Gmail. Everything personal is set in the variables below, photos come from a folder, so run one container per person.

Config.Name: Port 01: Web UI
Config.Description: Point your reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Path 01: Photos
Config.Description: One subfolder per gallery (featured, fauna, people, landscape, urban, film) plus about/ for the profile photo. Add --full, --isolate or --feature to a file name for layout flags.

Config.Name: Path 02: Photo Cache
Config.Description: Resized photos, kept across updates.

Config.Name: Path 03: Config
Config.Description: Optional: a content.js here replaces all the settings below (for captions and custom photo order).

Config.Name: Var 01: Name
Config.Description: Shown in the header, the About panel and the page title.

Config.Name: Var 02: Slogan
Config.Description: Short line under the name. Leave empty to hide.

Config.Name: Var 03: Bio
Config.Description: Two or three sentences for the About panel.

Config.Name: Var 04: City
Config.Description: Shown as 'City, Country' in the About panel.

Config.Name: Var 06: Profile Photo
Config.Description: Path inside the photos folder, e.g. about/me.jpg. Empty = first image in photos/about/.

Config.Name: Var 07: Instagram
Config.Description: Full URL. Empty = hidden.

Config.Name: Var 08: X
Config.Description: Full URL.

Config.Name: Var 09: Facebook
Config.Description: Full URL.

Config.Name: Var 10: LinkedIn
Config.Description: Full URL.

Config.Name: Var 11: Behance
Config.Description: Full URL.

Config.Name: Var 12: Flickr
Config.Description: Full URL.

Config.Name: Var 13: YouTube
Config.Description: Full URL.

Config.Name: Var 14: Public Email
Config.Description: Address shown as an email icon. Empty = hidden.

Config.Name: Var 15: Galleries
Config.Description: Which galleries to show, in order. Each one reads the folder of the same name inside Photos.

Config.Name: Var 16: Show Placeholders
Config.Description: true = empty galleries show stand-in photos; false = hide empty galleries.

Config.Name: Var 17: Contact Recipient
Config.Description: Where contact-form messages are sent.

Config.Name: Var 18: Gmail Address
Config.Description: Gmail account that sends contact-form messages.

Config.Name: Var 19: Gmail App Password
Config.Description: 16-character app password (Google Account > Security > App passwords).

Config.Name: Var 20: Behind A Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: true when Traefik, Pangolin, nginx or similar is in front.
